svg.text: 24 wall labels written from a photograph alone: 328 claims, held against the museum's record
94 confirmed · 12 contradicted · 222 the record cannot check
Sent the record: all 12 contradicted claims corrected. Of the 91 the makers brought from their own knowledge:
63 kept beside the record · 28 dropped · the revised labels carry 95 claims of the makers' own
The Met Open Access (CC0), twelve objects, two makers each; coding by the conductor, rules committed first (predictions.md).
